scientific_warning: Design hypotheses, NOT independent Oracle. Execute real baselines and freeze external Oracle separately.

scenarios.title: Normal release: all gates and closure evidence satisfied
scenarios.injection: No injection; three-stage health checks, artifact digest, and signal dispositions all normal
scenarios.b1_action: Real attestation issued and verified successfully
scenarios.evidence: Complete CI logs, artifact digest, upstream events, and B2 decision

scenarios.title: Authorized gate waiver
scenarios.injection: Scan gate WAIVED; policy permits, approver valid, approval time before cutoff
scenarios.b0_action: Record approval and gate state per the real waiver policy; do not fabricate tool-native waivers
scenarios.b1_action: Provenance attestation verified as for a normal artifact
scenarios.evidence: Original policy and approval events, gate states, B2 decision

scenarios.title: Successor obligation fulfilled
scenarios.injection: Generate a Finding after cutoff, bind the correct Requirement, target release verified
scenarios.b0_action: Existing release gates run as usual (no claim of native Finding linkage)
scenarios.b1_action: Verify provenance of the target artifact for real
scenarios.evidence: Finding/Requirement/Target time series, source snapshot hashes

scenarios.title: Missing effective disposition
scenarios.injection: Remove the effective Disposition of SIG-002 while keeping the independent raw inventory
scenarios.b0_action: Real gates run faithfully; the defect is injected only at the evidence disposition layer
scenarios.b1_action: Real attestation verification; do not assume it checks dispositions
scenarios.evidence: Difference between raw and disposition sets, failure codes

scenarios.title: Two effective dispositions for one identity
scenarios.injection: Add a second effective Disposition for SIG-002
scenarios.b0_action: Real tests pass or judge per configuration
scenarios.b1_action: Real provenance attestation verified as usual
scenarios.evidence: Both original Dispositions, timing and uniqueness failure codes

scenarios.title: Candidate unresolved
scenarios.injection: Mark the SIG-002 disposition UNRESOLVED with the corresponding Candidate status OPEN
scenarios.b0_action: Gates actually run; do not fake standard-gate judgments on business pending items

scenarios.title: Unauthorized disposition exclusion
scenarios.injection: Apply AUTHORIZED_EXCLUDED to SIG-002 where the actor lacks policy permission
scenarios.b0_action: Keep real policies and approval roles

scenarios.title: Raw signal identity-digest mismatch
scenarios.injection: Modify the raw payload of SIG-002 without updating its payload_sha256
scenarios.b0_action: Real tests and artifact digest checks run as usual
scenarios.b1_action: Verify the real artifact; do not assume artifact provenance can verify business signal payloads
scenarios.evidence: Original payload and digest, digest-verification failure code

scenarios.title: Raw evidence arriving after cutoff
scenarios.injection: Place occurrence/receipt time of SIG-002 after the source release cutoff
scenarios.b0_action: B0 runs as usual; keep gate times and injection times

scenarios.title: Wrong Finding-to-Requirement identity binding
scenarios.injection: Point the Finding's creates relation to a different Finding ID while keeping the target seemingly satisfied
scenarios.b0_action: B0 runs per the configured process
scenarios.evidence: source finding and creates_requirement wrong edge, failure_code

scenarios.title: Target release validation failed or incomplete
scenarios.injection: Finding successor relation valid, target due, but the real target validation status is FAIL
scenarios.b0_action: B0 runs as usual for the source release; a target release must run real tests
scenarios.b1_action: Record the real attestation result for the target artifact
scenarios.evidence: target due, target validation result, audit failure codes

scenarios.title: Later attempt to rewrite a historical frozen snapshot
scenarios.injection: Keep the frozen payload/hash, modify the observed/current snapshot payload
scenarios.b0_action: Preserve the original cutoff decision of the source release and the later update facts
scenarios.b1_action: Do not overstate attestation capability as historical snapshot audit
scenarios.evidence: original frozen hash, later observed payload hash, historical result retention value

scenarios.title: Raw signal population boundary not independently confirmable
scenarios.injection: Remove collector completeness and query-scope attestations (keep extracted signals)
scenarios.b0_action: Real gates run normally; record which class of raw evidence is missing
scenarios.evidence: List of missing materials with NFI marker; must not claim data omission is proven

scenarios.title: Source release attribution of a Finding unresolved
scenarios.injection: Keep the Finding trigger facts, set source_release_id to null; must not empty the obligation set
scenarios.evidence: finding observed facts, source attribution NFI, obligations that did not disappear

scenarios.title: Standard gates must detect: real unit test failure
scenarios.injection: Set INJECT_B01=1 to make an actual unittest case fail; record the gate FAIL
scenarios.b0_action: Actually execute the failing test, store the original exit code and error
scenarios.b1_action: Keep the B0 test failure; must not mask it with attestation
scenarios.evidence: Original unittest failure stdout and workflow failure, B2 gate failure codes

scenarios.title: Standard existing provenance tool must detect: artifact substitution after signing
scenarios.injection: After actions/attest signing, modify the pyz bytes and run gh attestation verify
scenarios.b0_action: The B0 artifact SHA pin must also actually verify; it may detect this as well
scenarios.b1_action: Real gh attestation verify must reject the modified artifact
scenarios.evidence: Pre/post-signing artifact SHAs, gh CLI exit and attestation bundle

scenarios.title: ZHFB R2: unresolved signals, failed gates, and cutoff
scenarios.injection: No controlled injection: only receive second-round raw project records and rebuild after source acceptance
scenarios.b0_action: Re-verify the source system's real gate execution records; do not claim green runs were misses
scenarios.b1_action: Report real results only if the tool was actually deployed; otherwise N/A
scenarios.evidence: Real source record IDs, extraction rules, native/curated split, independent Oracle

scenarios.title: ZHFB R3: 11:00 cutoff vs 11:10 post-release smoke
scenarios.injection: No controlled injection: re-verify historical visibility and gate policy
scenarios.b0_action: Re-verify whether the 11:10 smoke was admitted by gates rather than judged a violation
scenarios.b1_action: Record N/A where the original system deployed no attestation tooling
scenarios.evidence: cutoff policy, source gate records, snapshot times, independent conclusions

scenarios.title: ZHFB R4: 6/6 dispositions yet the snapshot stays frozen
scenarios.injection: No controlled injection: first obtain why it stayed frozen and the source of right-censoring
scenarios.b0_action: Reconstruct all actual gates and release decisions
scenarios.b1_action: Mark N/A per actual tool deployment
scenarios.evidence: Original freeze reason, state history, right-censoring explanation, raw records
